nodes.label: Deployment Configuration
nodes.rationale: Preconfigured for deployment on both Vercel and Netlify (via netlify.toml) supporting Bun builds and Next.js runtime.

nodes.label: Branching Strategy
nodes.rationale: Structured branching model (main for production, develop for integration, feature/ and bugfix/ branches) to maintain codebase stability and smooth release flow.

nodes.label: Code Style & TypeScript Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Strict TypeScript typing without any to ensure type safety, validated with Prettier and ESLint.

nodes.label: Architecture & Technology Stack
nodes.rationale: Engineered using Next.js React framework, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Supabase, and Recharts to provide secure authentication, real-time analytics, and glassmorphic UI design.

nodes.label: Secure Development Practices
nodes.rationale: Adhere to code reviews, automated dependency scanning, SAST static analysis, principle of least privilege, and end-to-end data encryption in transit and at rest to minimize security vulnerabilities.
